title: Market Metrics That Matter: U.S. Cash Equities October Volume Briefing
summary: Cboe Global Markets, a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.
body_markdown:
## October Macro Picture


- Total Consolidated Volume (TCV) increased 2.67% month-over-month in October to an Average Daily Volume (ADV) of 17.3 billion shares. Trade Reporting Facility (TRF) volume as a percent of TCV declined slightly to 49.9%.
- TCV remains significantly below the ADV of 20.1 billion shares in the first half of 2026.
- October’s closing auction volume declined 13% month-over-month after outsized gains in September.
- Cboe Market Close (CMC), an alternative cross on Cboe BZX Equities Exchange (BZX) for Market On-Close (MOC), orders had significant activity, executing across 1,395 unique symbols.


## Product update: Cboe EDGX Equities Exchange (EDGX) Retail Price Improvement (RPI)


- Members continued to use the RPI order type to interact exclusively with retail-attested orders that remove liquidity.
- October RPI ADV exceeded 1.1 million shares, the highest monthly ADV since launch in April 2026.
- Price movement following RPI executions has remained minimal
- [U.S. Equities: Retail Price Improvement | Cboe](https://www.cboe.com/markets/us/equities/trading/retail-price-improvement#edgx-retail-price-improvement)


## Cboe Market Close (CMC)


- CMC is a cost-effective alternative to primary market closing auctions and off-exchange venues for execution of Market On-Close (MOC) orders.
- 1,395 unique symbols traded via CMC throughout October.
- CMC runs on BZX exchange at 3:15 p.m., 3:30 p.m., 3:49 p.m. and 3:54 p.m. ET. CMC at 3:54 p.m. ET only trades NASDAQ listed symbols.
- CMC accepts MOC orders only.
- [Cboe U.S. Equities Exchanges Cboe Market Close](https://www.cboe.com/us/equities/trading/offerings/cboe_market_close/)


## Quote Depletion Protection (QDP)


- Member usage of QDP in October was robust, averaging 41 million shares daily across Cboe EDGX Equities Exchange (EDGX) and Cboe EDGA Equities Exchange (EDGA).
- For the month of October, when QDP was activated, it correctly predicted quote instability 76% of the time protecting members against unfavorable executions and maintaining solid on exchange performance. Cboe’s QDP measures the price movement of the NBBO to determine correct prediction, false prediction or static.
- [Cboe U.S. Equities Exchanges Midpoint Discretionary Order](https://www.cboe.com/us/equities/trading/offerings/midpoint_discretionary_order/)


## 23x5 U.S. Equities Trading on EDGX


- 23x5 U.S. equities trading on EDGX is scheduled to begin December 6, 2026, subject to regulatory approval and industry readiness.
- Member firms that are not self-clearing are required to have a clearing letter of guarantee signed by their clearing firm.

## BIDS Trading


BIDS Trading is a registered broker-dealer and the operator of the BIDS ATS, which is designed to bring counterparties together to anonymously trade blocks of stock.


**October Trading Statistics**


- Average Daily Volume*: 260.4 million shares
- Average Block† Execution Size: 22,343 shares
- Blocks† Traded as % of Total Traded Volume: 28%
- Block Trades Larger Than 50,000 Shares: 2,344
- Average Daily Block† Volume: 73.5 million shares


** Figures include all volume traded on the BIDS ATS and do not include any routed volume. Shares are double counted to include both sides of the transaction.*


*† BIDS block volume statistics reflect only transactions of 10,000+ shares.*


**Feature of the month: Leadership in Block Trading**


- BIDS ATS is the largest ATS for block† volume traded
- 20% of all ATS block† volume was traded on the BIDS ATS
- Globally, 516 firms have connections via BIDS Trader as of September 2026.
